_about: Which games played on later hardware count toward each original system's card on the planned Systems tab. Ronjan's decisions 2026-11-20 via the Re-release Mapping review page. Match by entry where noted (Vice City: PS4 classic only; Mass Effect 1/2: 360 versions only; KOTOR: Xbox play only). Rules: remasters and remakes are out; collections of the exact originals are in, and a mixed collection goes to the system that got most of its play.
